dara: Sales ping  BigFin wants a 12mo reserved commit scoped to embedding routes with per-route QPS + monthly burst pool. They want carryover for unused burst for 2 months. Can product/infra/legal scope?
kevin: short answer: yes if we limit MVP to embeddings only and quantized configs. Need pricing bands and clear cancellation/credit rules.
olga: propose product name: "Route Reserve Flex". MVP: per-route QPS field, burst bucket, carryover cap (2 months), console controls, billing SKU + API. No gen/chat in MVP.
nate: infra notes: implement per-tenant token bucket with carryover ledger + scheduler soft reservations. Extra monitoring + preemption logic. ETA ~3 infra sprints.
sophia: pricing anchors: Starter (no reserve), Reserve (reserved qps, no SLA), Reserve+ (reserved qps + burst carryover + SLA/support). Ballpark: Reserve ~$12k/mo for 20 QPS; Reserve+ ~$30k/mo incl SLA buffer. Need sensitivity table.
legal-anna: legal: avoid wording like "guarantee". Use "commercially reasonable efforts". Define credit calc for missed reserved capacity; cap exposure (e.g., <= 40% monthly fee). Add cancellation notice (30d) and early-termination fee if <6mo. Private deployment variant will need KMS/residency clauses and higher pricing.
dara: draft launch criteria: 1) billing SKU & price table 2) console + API controls 3) scheduler + token ledger + carryover logic 4) fallback policy + monitoring 5) runbook + pilot with 3 customers 6) legal contract variants.
kevin: negotiation levers to propose to BigFin: cap monthly burst (e.g., 2M ops), automatic fallback on exhaustion, carryover cap, and a 90-day pilot. Sales ok with pilot?
olga: owners & next actions: olga (product spec & console), nate (infra plan & cost), sophia (pricing), legal-anna (contract language), dara (sales coordination). I'll open ticket PROD-9991.
ops-bot: created ticket PROD-9991: Route Reserve Flex (assignee: olga)
dara: weekly sync Fridays 9am PT. Thanks all :thumbsup:
